instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: Software science measures were developed by...
options: M. Halstead here
B. Littlewood
T. J. McCabe now
G. Rothermal too
options_en: M. Halstead here
B. Littlewood
T. J. McCabe now
G. Rothermal too
questions.explanation: Maurice Halstead built the software science family of measures from operator and operand counts.
questions.explanation_ar: موريس هالستيد بنى عائلة مقاييس علم البرمجيات من عدّ المعاملات والمتغيرات.

questions.question: How is the vocabulary of a program defined?
options: the ratio between them here too here
the sum of unique operators and operands
the product of unique operators and operands
the difference between them now again
options_ar: الفرق بينهما هنا أيضاً هنا أيضاً
options_en: the ratio between them here too here
the sum of unique operators and operands
the product of unique operators and operands
the difference between them now again
questions.explanation: Vocabulary adds the count of distinct operators to the count of distinct operands.
questions.explanation_ar: المعجم يجمع عدد المعاملات المتميزة مع عدد المتغيرات المتميزة.

questions.question: What does Halstead mean when he says volume is measured in bits?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يعني هالستيد بأن الحجم يُقاس بالبت؟
options: the bits needed to execute it here
none of the above here now too now
the storage the program needs again
its size under uniform binary encoding
options_ar: لا شيء مما سبق هنا الآن هنا
options_en: the bits needed to execute it here
none of the above here now too now
the storage the program needs again
its size under uniform binary encoding
questions.explanation: Volume is the information content of the program if every token were encoded uniformly.
questions.explanation_ar: الحجم هو محتوى المعلومات في البرنامج لو رُمّز كل رمز ترميزاً موحداً.

questions.question: In Halstead theory, effort is measured in...
questions.question_ar: في نظرية هالستيد، يُقاس الجهد بـ...
options: hours here now again too now
elementary mental discriminations
none of the above now again
person-months too here here
options_en: hours here now again too now
elementary mental discriminations
none of the above now again
person-months too here here
questions.explanation: Effort counts the elementary mental discriminations a programmer must make.
questions.explanation_ar: الجهد يعدّ التمييزات الذهنية الأولية التي يقوم بها المبرمج.

questions.question: How is the language level defined?
options: the square of level times volume
level times volume here now again
level times potential volume
level cubed times volume too
options_en: the square of level times volume
level times volume here now again
level times potential volume
level cubed times volume too
questions.explanation: The language level rises with the square of the level, scaled by the volume.
questions.explanation_ar: مستوى اللغة يرتفع بمربع المستوى مضروباً بالحجم.

questions.question: Which one is NOT a measure of software science theory?
questions.question_ar: أي واحد ليس مقياساً في نظرية علم البرمجيات؟
options: logic now
vocabulary
volume too
level here
options_en: logic now
vocabulary
volume too
level here
questions.explanation: The family covers vocabulary, length, volume, level, difficulty and effort; logic is not one.
questions.explanation_ar: العائلة تشمل المعجم والطول والحجم والمستوى والصعوبة والجهد، و«المنطق» ليس منها.

questions.question: How many elementary mental discriminations can a human mind make per second?
questions.question_ar: كم تمييزاً ذهنياً أولياً يقدر العقل البشري على إجرائه في الثانية؟
options: one to ten here
forty to eighty
five to twenty
twenty to forty
options_en: one to ten here
forty to eighty
five to twenty
twenty to forty
questions.explanation: Halstead took the human discrimination rate as five to twenty per second.
questions.explanation_ar: اعتبر هالستيد معدل التمييز البشري من خمسة إلى عشرين في الثانية.

questions.question: What name did Halstead give to the minimal implementation of an algorithm?
questions.question_ar: أي اسم أطلقه هالستيد على التنفيذ الأدنى للخوارزمية؟
options: potential volume again here
effective volume here
none of the above now
volume here now too too
options_en: potential volume again here
effective volume here
none of the above now
volume here now too too
questions.explanation: The potential volume is the smallest form the algorithm could take in an ideal language.
questions.explanation_ar: الحجم الكامن هو أصغر صورة للخوارزمية في لغة مثالية.

questions.question: How is program volume computed?
options: length times log base two of vocabulary
half the length times that log again
twice the length times that log now too
that log plus one here now too here
options_ar: الطول مضروباً بلوغاريتم المعجم أساس اثنين
نصف الطول مضروباً بذلك اللوغاريتم أيضاً
ضعف الطول مضروباً بذلك اللوغاريتم مجدداً هنا
ذلك اللوغاريتم زائد واحد هنا الآن هنا
options_en: length times log base two of vocabulary
half the length times that log again
twice the length times that log now too
that log plus one here now too here
questions.explanation: Volume is the program length multiplied by the base-two logarithm of the vocabulary.
questions.explanation_ar: الحجم هو طول البرنامج مضروباً بلوغاريتم المعجم أساس اثنين.

questions.question: What is the relationship between difficulty and level?
options: difficulty is the log of level too
difficulty is the reciprocal of level
difficulty equals level here now again
difficulty is the square of level
options_en: difficulty is the log of level too
difficulty is the reciprocal of level
difficulty equals level here now again
difficulty is the square of level
questions.explanation: Difficulty rises exactly as the program level falls, so the two are reciprocals.
questions.explanation_ar: الصعوبة ترتفع بمقدار انخفاض مستوى البرنامج، فهما متعاكسان.
